title: Gemma 4 31B-it
summary: A frontier-level 31-billion parameter open-weight model by Google DeepMind with native multimodality and reasoning capabilities. It features a 256k context window and achieves state-of-the-art performance in coding, mathematics, and agentic tasks.
research_notes: Transitioned to a fully permissive Apache 2.0 license with the v4 release, significantly boosting adoption for commercial and local 'Sovereign AI' deployments.

evolution.summary: In May 2026, Google released Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) drafters for the 31B model, providing up to a 3x speedup in inference. The model continues to lead open-weight leaderboards, rivaling much larger closed models in reasoning tasks.
